SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sianadb.market.category C WHERE 1 = 1 AND ca_use = 'Y'
AND ca_org_idx = #{caOrgIdx}

SELECT C.ca_idx , C.ca_id , C.ca_name , C.ca_depth , C.ca_parent_id , C.ca_seq , C.ca_use , C.ca_point , C.ca_org_idx , O.or_name FROM sianadb.market.category C LEFT JOIN sianadb.market.org O ON C.ca_org_idx = o.or_idx WHERE 1 = 1 AND O.or_name IS NOT NULL
AND C.ca_org_idx = #{caOrgIdx}

SELECT C.ca_idx , C.ca_id , C.ca_name , C.ca_depth , C.ca_parent_id , CASE WHEN C.ca_depth > 1 THEN ( SELECT ca_name FROM sianadb.market.category WHERE ca_id = C.ca_parent_id limit 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS ca_parent_name , C.ca_seq , C.ca_use , C.ca_point , C.ca_org_idx , O.or_name FROM sianadb.market.category C LEFT JOIN sianadb.market.org O ON C.ca_org_idx = O.or_idx WHERE 1 = 1 AND C.ca_idx = #{caIdx}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sianadb.market.category C WHERE 1 = 1 AND (ca_id = #{caId} OR ca_name = #{caName})
